contractList.title: Contracts
contractList.intro: The organiser's Data Pack (100 contracts) plus demo seed contracts. A contract's status aggregates the engine's decision on each milestone (spec section 9.3).

filters.searchPlaceholder: Search code, title, buyer or supplier

waiting.draft: Complete the file and digitise the terms

modal.cancelBody: Cancel the signing of {{code}} and return it to draft. Only possible while nobody has signed; the action is logged.
modal.cancelled: Signing cancelled; the contract is a draft again

contractUpload.title: Register a new contract

positionsNotice.title: Signature positions are assigned in the next step
positionsNotice.body: Positions are not detected automatically. Next, you place one slot on the PDF page for each signer, in the order above.

file.label: Contract file
file.constraint: PDF or DOCX, up to 20 MB
file.replaceHint: Replacing the file after configuration forces a new check of the signature positions and the digitized copy, so that no signature lands in the wrong place.

errors.type: Only PDF or DOCX files are accepted.
errors.size: The file is larger than 20 MB.

appendix.label: Attached appendices
appendix.drop: Drag and drop or choose appendix files

signers.label: Signers and signing order
signers.hint: Two to four people, at least one per side. They sign top to bottom; the last must use a digital signature. When the last one signs, the buyer's CONTRACT_SIGNED event is recorded (matrix 4.2).

errors.count: Two to four signers are needed.
errors.missing: Pick a person for every step.
errors.bothSides: At least one signer per side is needed.

errors.INVALID_VALUE: The value must be positive with at most two decimals.
errors.INVALID_DATES: The start date must not be after the end date.
errors.INVALID_SUPPLIER: Pick a supplier of the Data Pack.
errors.SIGNER_COUNT: Two to four signers are needed.
errors.INVALID_SIGNER: Signers must belong to their side and not repeat.
errors.SIGNERS_BOTH_SIDES: At least one signer per side is needed.
errors.INVALID_REVIEWER: The reviewer must be a buyer contract officer.
errors.DRAFT_LOCKED: The terms are locked; cancel the signing to edit.
errors.INVALID_CODE: The contract code changed; reload the page.
errors.BUYER_EDITORS_ONLY: Only buyer contract officers and owners can create a file.
errors.UNKNOWN: The file could not be saved.

ready.title: Ready to assign signature positions.
ready.detail: The signing flow has {{steps}} steps, each needing a signature box on the PDF page.

unsigned.title: No digital signature yet
unsigned.detail: in the file: expected for a new contract.

contractUpload.intro: Step 1/5. A new contract is cut into milestones by the Data Pack workflow of its type, so the same rules as the organiser's 405 milestones apply.
